_comment: Hand-maintained corrections for champion coverage, each shown in the report as kind 'override' (or in a stun verb's note) with its note. items: item hash -> { champion: barrier | overload | unstoppable | none, note }, replacing everything else known about the item. plugs: plug hash -> { champion, note }, granted to every item rolled with the plug. verbs: { champion, element, verb, note }, a stun verb the game's triumph text doesn't list, matched in ability and perk text in all its forms. Put the source and date in each note.

2978966579.note: Chill Clip: confirmed in play (2026-10) to stun Unstoppables; its text only says it slows

344235611.note: Enhanced Chill Clip: confirmed in play (2026-10) to stun Unstoppables; its text only says it slows

verbs.note: freezing stuns Unstoppables, confirmed in play (2026-10); the game's triumph text only lists shatter
